_comment: Step 1 of the burst workflow (Data Selection), emtk app: the assignment table, one row per role made from the detector setup (Measurement, Buffer, and per colour IRF and Reference dye), each listing the files, workspace groups and datasets assigned to it, as a tree over BurstDataSelectionApp.assignment_rows. Every column carries a tooltip.

sections.title: What this workflow works on
sections.description: One row per role: the measurements (searched for bursts), the buffer, and for every colour of the detector setup an IRF and a reference dye. Drag workspace data from the table above onto a row to assign it; drag an entry onto another row, or right-click it › Move to, to change its role. A workspace group is one entry; unfold it for its files. Delete removes the selected entry. A reference row's Dye cell chooses its dye.

context_menu.label: Move to
context_menu.description: Assign this entry to another row.

context_menu.label: Remove
context_menu.description: Take this file, group or row's files out of the workflow.

columns.title: Role / data
columns.tooltip: A role (measurement, buffer, IRF or reference dye of a colour), and under it what is assigned to it: a workspace group as one entry, single files as themselves.

columns.title: Files
columns.tooltip: How many files the role or group holds.

columns.title: Dye
columns.tooltip: The reference dye of this colour, from the dye database (its D at 25 °C in water, corrected to the temperature of the measurement): found in the file's header or name, else the colour's usual dye. Click to choose another, or Other (custom D).

columns.title: G
columns.tooltip: G factor of the colour's detectors (VV/VH tail ratio of the reference dye), written to the setup. Typically 0.8–1.3; 1 means equal detection of both polarisations.

columns.title: V_eff (fL)
columns.tooltip: Effective confocal volume from the reference dye. About 0.5–2 fL for a well-aligned confocal; larger means a defocused or underfilled objective.

columns.title: τ_D (µs)
columns.tooltip: Diffusion time of the reference dye through the focus. Rh110 in a 0.5 µm focus: about 100–200 µs.

columns.title: w0 (µm)
columns.tooltip: Lateral 1/e² radius of the focus. About 0.2–0.6 µm.

columns.title: s
columns.tooltip: Structure parameter z0/w0. s ≈ 3–8 for a well-aligned confocal; much larger means a long, poorly defined focus.

columns.title: cpm (kHz)
columns.tooltip: Brightness of one molecule of the reference dye: count rate / N. Higher is better; it drops with misalignment and saturation.

columns.title: B (kHz)
columns.tooltip: Background rate of the buffer, all detectors (per detector in the row's tooltip). Below about 2 kHz per detector is good.

columns.title: IRF (ps)
columns.tooltip: Width (FWHM) of the measured IRF. A few hundred ps for SPADs, under 100 ps for hybrid detectors.

columns.title: Status
columns.tooltip: measured, estimated (no file: estimated from the measurement), computing …, or hand-edited (the setup's G was changed by hand and is kept). The row's tooltip says more.

columns.title: MMFDB
columns.tooltip: Whether the file is stored in the MMFDB object store and registered as raw TTTR data.
